newsitem.title: ITALY: BankItaly vigilant over lira, but discreet-dealers.
newsitem.headline: BankItaly vigilant over lira, but discreet-dealers.

text.p: The lira was trying to test support at 1,003 per mark on Monday afternoon with the Bank of Italy keeping a close, but discreet, watch, foreign exchange dealers said.

"The Bank is making its presence felt, but one has the feeling it want to exercise moral persuasion rather than intervene on a grand scale," one dealer said, adding, "if the Bank had been intervening heavily movements on the crosses would have been much more violent."
Other dealers noted that with a market trend so clearly against the Italian currency, the Bank could really do little.
"Going against the market when the trend is no clear has no sense," said one dealer who had seen no central bank intervention this afternoon.
"Levels between 1,002 and 1,005 per mark might not be great but they are acceptable when the dollar is so weak," he added.
This morning dealers saw the Bank of Italy selling marks around 999 lire.
At 1537 GMT, the lira was quoted at 1,002.80/3.10 per mark.
